statement: The spinless E sector is C_L^2 tensor F(c0, b), dim G=4, N_E=1. Balanced capacitance gives Pn_iP=(I+n_b+Z_i)/3, sum Z_i=0, so logical–gauge cross terms cancel and aligned triangles give H_L=deltaV(XX+ZZ)/6. Identical dark offsets FAIL: resonant(1,1)<->(0,2)has leakage-amplitude2/3at useful time independent of weakening V. Staggering separates the desired K=3 sector. The worker finite-band Sylvester theorem requires retained half-width B<Delta/2; its floating finite-gauge checks do not establish arbitrary-bath protection. Spin filtering/one-orbital initialization and actual balanced operator geometry remain required.
